title: OpenSpec – A lightweight and configurable AI spec framework
title_zh: OpenSpec – 一个轻量级且可配置的AI规范框架

paragraphs.en: OpenSpec is a lightweight and configurable framework for creating and managing software specifications.
paragraphs.zh: OpenSpec 是一个轻量级且可配置的框架，用于创建和管理软件规格说明。

paragraphs.en: With OpenSpec, you capture what you want to build in a spec and keep your team and coding agents aligned as the work evolves. We help you refine the requirements, validate that they describe the right thing, and verify that the implementation matches.
paragraphs.zh: 借助 OpenSpec，你可以把想要构建的内容记录在规格说明中，并在工作推进过程中让团队和智能体保持一致。 我们帮助你完善需求、验证需求是否描述了正确的东西，并核实实现是否与之相符。

sents.en: With OpenSpec, you capture what you want to build in a spec and keep your team and coding agents aligned as the work evolves.
sents.zh: 借助 OpenSpec，你可以把想要构建的内容记录在规格说明中，并在工作推进过程中让团队和智能体保持一致。

sents.en: We help you refine the requirements, validate that they describe the right thing, and verify that the implementation matches.
sents.zh: 我们帮助你完善需求、验证需求是否描述了正确的东西，并核实实现是否与之相符。

paragraphs.en: In essence, OpenSpec helps you build the right thing and build it right .
paragraphs.zh: 本质上，OpenSpec 帮助你构建正确的东西，并以正确的方式构建它。

paragraphs.en: 72.1k GitHub stars. A new spec every two seconds .
paragraphs.zh: 72.1k GitHub 星标。 每两秒一份新规范。

sents.en: A new spec every two seconds .

paragraphs.en: A new spec is created with OpenSpec every two seconds .
paragraphs.zh: 每两秒就会有一个新的规范通过 OpenSpec 创建。

paragraphs.en: OpenSpec helps create a new spec every two seconds , has earned 72.1k GitHub stars , and is used by more than 265,000 developers a month .
paragraphs.zh: OpenSpec 每两秒就能创建一个新规范，已获得 72.1k GitHub 星标，每月被超过 265,000 名开发者使用。

paragraphs.en: OpenSpec is already part of how developers build with AI. 1 A new spec is created every two seconds. 2
paragraphs.zh: OpenSpec 已经成为开发者使用 AI 进行构建的方式的一部分。¹ 每两秒就会创建一个新规范。²
